in_sanskrit.name: Baalaraju
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Cows
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Baalaraju एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Baalaraju is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Baal' (Lord) and 'Raju' (Ruler of Cows). In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the deity Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector of cows. Baalaraju represents strength, compassion, and the divine power of nurturing and protecting.
